card.name: Words just before a numeric value or range
card.fires_on: Words right before a number or range is expected, such as the 'olic' in systolic, 'concentration', or 'defined' before a range. Seen in dosing labels and in science text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a following number or range word and away from Chinese or English number-approximation words.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a number or range coming next, like systolic or concentration.
